findings.title: SQL Injection
findings.description: User-controlled value req.query.patientName is concatenated into a SQL string passed to db.raw(). Tainted data reaches a sink without parameterization.

findings.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
findings.description: req.query.patientName is reflected in the response body returned to the client without output encoding.

findings.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
findings.description: A string literal that appears to be a credential is used as a default value.

findings.title: Information Exposure Through Error Message
findings.description: err.stack is returned to the client on the /search failure path.

findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Authentication Endpoint
findings.description: The /login handler has no throttling, lockout, or backoff on repeated failures.

findings.title: Permissive Cross-Origin Resource Sharing
findings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is set from the request Origin header.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: No helmet() / HSTS / CSP / X-Content-Type-Options middleware configured.

findings.title: Command Injection in lodash template()
findings.description: lodash < 4.17.21 is vulnerable to command injection via the template function.

findings.title: XSRF-TOKEN disclosure to third-party host in axios
findings.description: axios >=1.0.0 <1.6.0 leaks the XSRF-TOKEN cookie in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on cross-origin requests.

findings.title: Prototype Pollution in minimist
findings.description: minimist <= 1.2.5 is vulnerable to prototype pollution via setKey().
